messages:
anna: quick sync: EU private deployment requires no long-lived KMS decrypt in-cluster. need netpol, RBAC, and auditable decrypts before handoff.

rafael: plan: collectors talk only to local sidecar. sidecar has no decrypt. short-lived proxy SA mints token to call KMS.

jo: netpol idea: restrict collector egress to sidecar podSelector + proxy CIDR. apply to canary ns.

anna: also customer wants decrypt events sent to their BigQuery and 90-day retention + daily digest.

rafael: alert rule: log metric for protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt" AND NOT principalEmail:"telemetry-proxy@*" -> PagerDuty.

jo: vuln note: sidecar v2.3 logs env on crash. mitigation: switch to projected tokens, block env secrets via admission, roll v2.4.

sec-oncall: INCIDENT BOT: CVE-2026-XXXX affecting sidecar. follow PRIV-ISOLATE playbook if exploit seen.

anna: action items: @rafael create proxy-sa TTL 15m, @jo apply netpol to canary, @anna wire audit sink to customer BQ.

deploy-bot: kubectl: networkpolicy/collector-egress-created in ns/canary-collector  3502003375

rafael: netpol applied, smoke passed: collector->sidecar OK, outbound blocked.

anna: scheduling customer demo for 3502003500. will update after canary. thanks all :thumbsup:
